podcast.title: Influence of Post-WWII American Pop Culture
podcast.body: In 2021, he revealed that his "internal world" and musical preferences were heavily influenced by "black and white movies from the 1940s and 50s," specifically mentioning Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, Jeanette McDonald and Nelson Eddy movies, Rogers and Hammerstein musicals, big band music (like Glenn Miller Orchestra), and jazz artists (like Count Basie), which he considers "the best music ever written." "in 2021 he said when I was growing up the fantasy world I inhabited was the fantasy world of the black and white movies from the 1940s and 50s such as the Fred Astaire and ginger Rogers movies and even the earlier movies of Jeanette McDonald and Nelson Eddie and of course all the musicals of Rogers and Hammerstein and the big band air. There are two like the Glen Miller orchestra and the jazz guys like Count Basie that's what I loved and to me it is still the best music ever written."
